paper.title: Multi-Attention-Powered Learning Genetic Algorithm for Real-World 3D Wind Farm Layout Optimization

predecessor_source.name: WFLO-GGA
predecessor_source.role: one-point crossover and repair convention only

population_input.normalization: sorted occupied cell index divided by grid cardinality minus 0.5
population_input.evidence: paper Section 4.2 defines Psi in R^(l by d), describes population-derived generation-updated samples, and Section 4.3 gives O(N D^2 + N^2 h); mapping rows to 30 individuals and normalized grid indices to d features is disclosed because l/d ownership is not unambiguous

query_projection.evidence: paper Eqs. 19-20 specifies W_Q in R^(d by d_k); Table 2 specifies eight heads; d_k=1 is disclosed reconstruction

key_projection.evidence: paper Eqs. 19-20 specifies W_K in R^(d by d_k); Table 2 specifies eight heads; d_k=1 is disclosed reconstruction

value_projection.evidence: paper Eqs. 19 and 22-23; value width one is disclosed reconstruction

attention_scores.evidence: paper Eqs. 20-21; dimensions [8,30,30] follow the disclosed l=population mapping and d_k=1

attended_values.evidence: paper Eqs. 22-23 under the disclosed l=population mapping

prediction.evidence: paper Eq. 23 and shallow-network statement; scalar prediction target, output width, and bias are disclosed reconstruction because the paper omits a supervised loss

network_depth.evidence: paper Section 4.2 states a shallow simple network and Eqs. 19-23 specify attention; omission of any additional hidden layer is disclosed reconstruction

initialization.evidence: paper does not specify initialization; disclosed reconstruction

target.evidence: paper does not specify a network target; disclosed reconstruction using already evaluated fitness

loss.evidence: paper does not specify a training loss; disclosed reconstruction

optimizer.evidence: paper Table 2 specifies learning rate 1e-3 and Algorithm 1 invokes network learning once per generation; optimizer, batching, and update count are otherwise disclosed reconstruction

mask_cardinality.evidence: disclosed reconstruction using paper mutation degree

evolution_bridge.selection_interface: paper Eq. 24 replaces masked low-attention position elements with a high-potential position sequence; the executable mapping uses mean received multi-head attention plus normalized fitness, aggregates by cell, and sources unoccupied high-attention cells from elites as an explicitly disclosed completion
evolution_bridge.physical_fes: initial 30 plus each evaluated non-elite offspring; attention training adds zero FES

claim_boundary: Paper-guided M3 declared reconstruction on separately identified problem proxies. It is not author ALGA source, data, learned state, or reported-result reproduction.
